{{Pagebanner|Test Banner.png|pgname=Belváros}}
'''Belváros''' or Downtown is the V. District of [[Budapest]]. It holds the [[Hungarian Parliament Building|Parliament]] and the ''Basilica''.
[[File:Hungary budapest district 5.jpg|thumb|right|District 5]]

== Get in ==
Take {{station|Deák Ferenc tér|M1}} or walk {{km|1.5}} from the river.
* {{go
| name=Vigadó tér pier | lat=47.49630 | long=19.04900
| content=Boats to Szentendre leave from here.
}}

== Stay safe ==
Pickpockets work the tram lines; keep valuables in inside pockets and watch bags.

== Go next ==
Szentendre is a short boat ride north and makes a pleasant day trip away from the city.
